goal: Materialize a real current-iPhone TVC recipient-key capability for Coinbase ingress using an opaque non-exportable P-256 key handle in the existing StegOS Mobile iOS target, while preserving TV/TVC credential authority, Interlock/InTr transition authority, no private-key export, and no second runtime owner.
required_implementation: Implement a TVC-owned iOS recipient capability adapter inside the existing StegOS Mobile target using Apple Security APIs and a non-exportable P-256 private key handle.
Bind key creation/liveness to a TVC namespace and emit only public key material, recipient_key_id, runtime_instance_id, lease metadata, and an opaque tvc-capability:// handle.
Do not expose raw private-key bytes to StegOS Mobile, ordinary KV, GitHub, logs, screenshots, argv, or provider payloads.
Provide a TVC-verifiable activation/liveness envelope compatible with stegverse.tvc.recipient-key-capability/v1 semantics.
Fail closed when Secure Enclave/non-exportability requirements cannot be satisfied; do not silently downgrade to an exportable software key for production proof.
Wire the capability into the existing Coinbase recipient activation seam without creating another runtime lifecycle or transition authority.
Validate source/build behavior, then require authentic current-iPhone activation before projecting READY_FOR_OWNER_INGRESS or producing a Gateway sidecar.
